events.text:
## Summary

**Built:** A single self-contained HTML clone of `https://laurent.qodeinteractive.com/about-us/` at `/Users/cameron/projects/gumshoe/experiments/control-subagent/output/2026-08-30T16-30-55-363Z/clone.html`, using Tailwind via CDN (configured with the site's actual palette — `#0b1315` ink background, `#c9ab81`/`#9c7c57` gold accents — and its real Google Fonts, Josefin Sans + Miniver, pulled from the page's own `<link>` tags). All images (hero, content photo, video-parallax background, header/footer logos) are hotlinked to the live site rather than rehosted. Nav labels, headings, body copy, testimonial text/authors, and footer address/hours/social links were all transcribed verbatim from the fetched HTML.

**JS-driven pieces handled specially:**
- The testimonial carousel (originally Owl Carousel) was rebuilt with **Swiper**, loaded from cdnjs — first attempt used a nonexistent cdnjs version (`11.1.4`, 404), caught during review and corrected to the real published version (`14.2.0`), which fixed the carousel from a broken stacked-list into a proper single-slide autoplay/pagination carousel.
- The video lightbox (prettyPhoto/Vimeo popup) was simplified to a direct link to the Vimeo URL rather than reimplementing a lightbox plugin — flagged here as the one simplification made.
- The full WordPress mega-menu (dozens of demo-page links) was intentionally not reproduced; only the real top-level nav items and the active "Pages" state were kept, since the dropdown is hover/JS-driven and irrelevant to the static comparison.

**Fidelity check:** Screenshotted both the live page and the draft at 1280×900 (plus full-page shots for layout context) through headless Chrome, iterated twice — fixing the Swiper CDN 404 and adding the page's vertical grid divider lines that run the full page height.

**Tuning sub-agent:** Ran once per instructions (`claude -p ... --model haiku`, foreground, ~full run). It reduced pixel-diff from ~30% to ~17%, but two of its changes were regressions: it stretched the hero section from the real 530px to 900px (pushing the title far down) and stacked the footer social links vertically (the live page has them in a horizontal row). I caught both against my own screenshots and reverted them to the correct values, keeping only its legitimate spacing refinements. Final screenshots confirm the corrected draft matches the live page closely.

All screenshots, diffs, and `tuning-result.json` are left in place in the output directory as the audit record (including files the tuning agent's own tooling wrote there).

resultText:
## Summary

**Built:** A single self-contained HTML clone of `https://laurent.qodeinteractive.com/about-us/` at `/Users/cameron/projects/gumshoe/experiments/control-subagent/output/2026-08-30T16-30-55-363Z/clone.html`, using Tailwind via CDN (configured with the site's actual palette — `#0b1315` ink background, `#c9ab81`/`#9c7c57` gold accents — and its real Google Fonts, Josefin Sans + Miniver, pulled from the page's own `<link>` tags). All images (hero, content photo, video-parallax background, header/footer logos) are hotlinked to the live site rather than rehosted. Nav labels, headings, body copy, testimonial text/authors, and footer address/hours/social links were all transcribed verbatim from the fetched HTML.

**JS-driven pieces handled specially:**
- The testimonial carousel (originally Owl Carousel) was rebuilt with **Swiper**, loaded from cdnjs — first attempt used a nonexistent cdnjs version (`11.1.4`, 404), caught during review and corrected to the real published version (`14.2.0`), which fixed the carousel from a broken stacked-list into a proper single-slide autoplay/pagination carousel.
- The video lightbox (prettyPhoto/Vimeo popup) was simplified to a direct link to the Vimeo URL rather than reimplementing a lightbox plugin — flagged here as the one simplification made.
- The full WordPress mega-menu (dozens of demo-page links) was intentionally not reproduced; only the real top-level nav items and the active "Pages" state were kept, since the dropdown is hover/JS-driven and irrelevant to the static comparison.

**Fidelity check:** Screenshotted both the live page and the draft at 1280×900 (plus full-page shots for layout context) through headless Chrome, iterated twice — fixing the Swiper CDN 404 and adding the page's vertical grid divider lines that run the full page height.

**Tuning sub-agent:** Ran once per instructions (`claude -p ... --model haiku`, foreground, ~full run). It reduced pixel-diff from ~30% to ~17%, but two of its changes were regressions: it stretched the hero section from the real 530px to 900px (pushing the title far down) and stacked the footer social links vertically (the live page has them in a horizontal row). I caught both against my own screenshots and reverted them to the correct values, keeping only its legitimate spacing refinements. Final screenshots confirm the corrected draft matches the live page closely.

All screenshots, diffs, and `tuning-result.json` are left in place in the output directory as the audit record (including files the tuning agent's own tooling wrote there).
